subject.title: codex: clean `final:true` / `sessions_yield` close interrupts the turn, writing a false "user interrupted" marker into the thread rollout

question: Should successful explicit `final:true` and `sessions_yield` delivery wait briefly for Codex `turn/completed`, with an interrupt only as a bounded fallback, rather than preserving immediate hard-stop behavior?
rationale: The defect is concrete, but the proposed deadline and behavior when new input arrives intentionally trade immediate teardown against a clean Codex rollout and must be chosen as product lifecycle semantics.

options.title: Adopt bounded graceful completion
options.body: Accept the linked PR's normal-completion path, while confirming its deadline and user-inbound fallback policy before merge.

options.title: Keep immediate interruption
options.body: Preserve current immediate teardown and accept that clean terminal delivery is represented upstream as an interrupted turn.

options.title: Request a narrower upstream-compatible policy
options.body: Keep the issue open while owners specify a different deadline or post-final-output rule for a revised implementation.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded graceful completion
recommendation.body: Accept the linked PR's normal-completion path, while confirming its deadline and user-inbound fallback policy before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged terminal-finalization work is the closest current-main ownership signal for the completion boundary under discussion.
